summary.text: Terrell McKinney is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 11, and was elected in 2020 and re-elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Terrell McKinney's occupation as a wrestling coach.

paragraphs.text: Terrell McKinney was born on August 17, 1990, in Omaha.

Terrell McKinney graduated from Omaha North High Magnet School in 2008, earned a B.S. in sports business management from Maryville University in 2014, and earned an MBA from Midland University in 2018.
Terrell McKinney worked as a community organizer and hunger action advocate at Nebraska Appleseed.
Terrell McKinney serves on the board of Black Men United and as finance chair of the Black Agenda Alliance.
